question: Do the rental income deposits shown on the bank statements align with the gross rental income reported for the property(ies) listed on the loan application (both subject and REO)?
rephrased_question: Are there any deposits that match the properties monthly gross rental income?
label: transaction_consistency
ground_truth_answer: Mismatch: Bank shows rental deposits of $7,500.00/month but application reports gross rental income of $8,000.00/month.
